# The DRIPBaR Burleson

> The DRIPBaR Burleson is an IV therapy and wellness lounge in Burleson, Texas. Services include IV vitamin drips, intramuscular quick shots, NAD+ infusions, High Dose Vitamin C, physician-guided GLP-1 medical weight management, medically supervised peptide therapy, and wellness therapies, delivered by a licensed clinical team under physician oversight. Every first visit begins with a brief health screening.

Key facts:
- Address: 295 E. Renfro St, Ste 207, Burleson, TX 76028
- Phone: (817) 241-2107 (call or text)
- Hours: Monday to Friday: 10 AM to 6 PM; Saturday: 10 AM to 4 PM; Sunday: 11 AM to 3 PM
- Booking: https://thedripbarburleson.com/booking (online, 24/7) or by phone
- Pricing: Lifestyle IV drips are $199 regular and $159 for members. Some drips (100% Hydration, NAD+, High Dose Vitamin C, add-on drips) are priced separately.
- New guest offer: New guests choose their experience and receive up to $100 worth of free perks on the first visit: a Lifestyle drip, a booster add-on, and one supportive therapy. No consultation fee.
- All IV drips and quick shots are administered by registered nurses under physician oversight. Nothing on this site is medical advice; a consultation is required for GLP-1, peptide, High Dose Vitamin C, Ozone Therapy, and NAD+ planning.
- High Dose Vitamin C, how it works: at everyday oral doses Vitamin C is an antioxidant. At the high concentrations an IV infusion reaches, it shifts to a pro-oxidant and produces hydrogen peroxide in the fluid around cells. Because the mechanism changes, high dose Vitamin C requires a consultation, a G6PD screening lab, individualized dosing (priced by dose), and physician oversight. It is supportive wellness care, not a treatment or cure for any disease.
